context.problem_statement: Evaluate a fraud detection classifier on a highly imbalanced dataset (approximately 5% fraud rate). Train a logistic regression model with and without SMOTE oversampling. For both models, compute precision, recall, F1-score, and area under the precision-recall curve (AUPRC). Report the confusion matrix for each. Explain why accuracy is a misleading metric for this task and which model better balances false positives vs false negatives in a fraud context.
context.expert_knowledge: For imbalanced classification, use class_weight='balanced' or SMOTE (imblearn.over_sampling.SMOTE). AUPRC is more informative than AUC-ROC for imbalanced datasets. In fraud detection, false negatives (missed fraud) typically cost more than false positives (false alarms). F1-score is the harmonic mean of precision and recall. Baseline accuracy = majority class rate = ~95%, making accuracy misleading.
